claims.claim: Arm Holdings plc identity/tradability is tied to NASDAQ:ARM; FY2026 20-F and Q1 FY2027 6-K/financial statements are current primary issuer/SEC lineage.

Issuer-hosted SEC filings are treated as one primary origin family; StockAnalysis/S&P Global lineage is retained only as independent market-valuation evidence and not double-counted as issuer evidence.

unknowns.unknown: Customer-level royalty concentration and SoftBank control implications require ongoing monitoring but do not prevent reproducible current scoring.

claims.claim: FY2026 revenue was $4.92B, up 22.8%, with $904M net income; Q4 FY2026 revenue was $1.49B, up 20%, with 97.9% GAAP gross margin.
At March 31, 2026 Arm held $2.751B cash plus $850M short-term investments and stated those resources were adequate for at least the next 12 months and longer term.
Current valuation embeds extreme expectations: approximately $284B market cap, 270x trailing P/E and 111x forward P/E on Sep. 18, 2026.

thesisQuality.basis: Arm's royalty/licensing model and broad compute IP footprint create a high-quality structural thesis, tempered by valuation and control concentration.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: FY2026 revenue grew 22.8% and earnings 14.1%; Q4 revenue grew 20% with very high gross margin.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: About $284B market cap with roughly 270x trailing and 111x forward P/E leaves little valuation margin of safety.

catalystScore.basis: AI/cloud/edge adoption and continued licensing/royalty conversion provide substantial forward catalysts; next earnings is Nov. 4, 2026.

governancePower.basis: Public-company reporting is current, but concentrated SoftBank ownership/control reduces minority-holder governance independence versus a widely held issuer.

alignment2036.basis: CPU, GPU, NPU, system IP and compute subsystems directly address heterogeneous AI/cloud/edge compute scaling.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Licensing, royalties, CSS and software/tooling reinforce one architecture ecosystem across mobile, cloud, automotive and edge markets.

bottleneckControl.basis: Arm architecture/IP is deeply embedded across semiconductor design ecosystems, creating an important compute-design control point without assuming monopoly power.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Diversified end markets and an asset-light IP model support resilience across compute scenarios, though architecture shifts remain a real counterfactual.

substitutionResilience.basis: Large installed software/developer ecosystem and pervasive architecture licensing create high switching friction; RISC-V remains the principal substitution threat.

supplyChainResilience.basis: IP licensing is comparatively asset-light and March liquidity exceeded $3.6B, reducing direct manufacturing supply-chain exposure.

pricingPower.basis: Near-98% Q4 GAAP gross margin and royalty/licensing economics demonstrate exceptional value capture, while customer bargaining power caps a perfect score.

riskEvidence.basis: Extreme valuation, concentrated control, semiconductor/customer cyclicality and open-architecture substitution can materially impair expected returns despite strong business quality.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current primary 20-F/Q1 filing plus current independent market valuation support all numeric components; customer-level concentration remains explicit non-gating uncertainty.

thesisQuality.basis: Broad royalty/licensing compute-IP footprint supports structural thesis.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: FY2026 and Q4 show strong double-digit growth and profitability.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Current triple-digit earnings multiples imply extreme expectations.

catalystScore.basis: AI/cloud/edge licensing and royalty conversion plus Nov. earnings create catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Current reporting is strong but concentrated control reduces governance independence.

alignment2036.basis: Architecture portfolio directly enables heterogeneous future compute.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Licensing, royalties, CSS and tools reinforce a common architecture ecosystem.

bottleneckControl.basis: Pervasive architecture/IP position creates a major compute-design control point.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Asset-light model and diversified compute end markets support robustness.

substitutionResilience.basis: Installed architecture/software ecosystem creates substantial switching friction.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Asset-light IP model and strong liquidity reduce direct manufacturing exposure.

pricingPower.basis: Near-98% Q4 GAAP gross margin demonstrates exceptional value capture.

riskEvidence.basis: Valuation, control concentration, cyclicality and architecture substitution are material risks.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current primary filings plus independent valuation evidence support reproducible scoring.
